children: The stock of K.P.R. Mill has been in an uptrend since April. Back then, it found support at ₹800 and established an uptrend.
Recently though, the stock has been witnessing higher volatility, particularly since second half of June. While the trend has not turned bearish, the direction of movement was largely sideways.
But now the stock found a support at ₹1,100, where a key rising trendline coincides. The rebound on Friday indicates that the stock might gain more strength going forward.
We see a potential for the stock to appreciate to ₹1,400 in the medium-term.
So, buy now at ₹1,141 and ₹1,100. Place stop-loss at ₹1,000. When the stock rallies to ₹1,250 and ₹1,340, alter the stop-loss to ₹1,190 and ₹1,300 respectively. Book profits at ₹1,400.
(Note: The recommendations are based on technical analysis. There is a risk of loss in trading.)

title: Stock to buy today: K.P.R. Mill (₹1,141.30)
